author: Tunstall, 1771
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수천 마리 · 텃새 수십 마리
habitat: 계곡, 하천, 연못 등 습지 주변
summary: 계곡, 하천, 연못 같은 습지 주변에 살며 우리나라에서 흔히 번식하는 여름철새이다. 돌 틈이나 건물 틈에 가는 줄기와 뿌리로 둥지를 짓는다. 땅에서 걸을 때 다른 할미새류처럼 꼬리를 위아래로 까딱이고, 날 때는 물결 모양으로 오르내리며, 나무 꼭대기나 전깃줄, 지붕, 바위 위에 앉아 운다. 국내 전역에 살고 국외에서는 러시아, 중국, 일본, 인도차이나에 분포한다.

points.en: black chin and throat patch in male
tail longer than in other wagtails

sexes.male: 전체적으로 색이 더 짙고 아랫면의 노란색이 더 선명하며, 턱밑과 멱에 검은 반점이 있다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 색이 엷고 턱밑과 멱에 검은 반점이 없다.

art.subject: Grey Wagtail (Motacilla cinerea), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen along Korean mountain streams from April to August: blue-grey crown, nape, mantle and back; a narrow white supercilium and a white submoustachial stripe framing grey ear-coverts; chin and throat black; rump yellowish-green; wings blackish with whitish edges to the tertials; underparts bright lemon-yellow, most intense on the vent and undertail coverts; long black tail with white outer tail feathers. Long, thin dark grey bill; dark eye; pink legs.
art.pose: walking on a streamside rock, bobbing its long tail up and down
art.scene: Korean summer mountain stream with rocks and a small pool; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view walking on a stream rock: blue-grey upperparts, white supercilium and submoustachial stripe, black chin and throat, conspicuous bright yellow underparts, very long black-and-white tail, long thin dark grey bill, pink legs
adult female, side view walking: grey upperparts, paler yellow underparts with a whitish throat and no black, long tail, the same dark grey bill and pink legs
art.build: Slender wagtail, 20cm long, of which nearly half is tail; body about the size of a sparrow's, but the tail clearly longer than in other wagtails. Short neck, horizontal stance; walks on stream rocks constantly pumping its rear body and tail up and down. Bill thin, straight and dark grey, shorter than the head. Legs short for a wagtail, pink. In flight a narrow white bar across the flight feathers and a deeply undulating flight path; tail long, narrow and square-ended, black with white sides.
avoid: Do not paint an olive-green back or black legs; those belong to Eastern Yellow Wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis), which also has a shorter tail.
Do not make the tail short; it is longer than in any other wagtail.
Do not paint a yellow head or a bold black-and-white head; the head is grey with thin white lines.
Do not give the female a black throat.
